_doc: The combat library (ADR-0001 step 3). Written by tools/design/combat_sim/export_combat_library.py from fight.py's library, ward parser, reference enemies and constants; do not edit by hand. Read by FighterCompiler. arts: library forms by id (build-file art fields, effects, counters, states; source family | part_common | part_authored | common_arts | item). items: named items' combat records (role = the base's first role; wards parsed and unscaled, fields null when not run). bases: per artifact base, its roles, common art id and common ward (Item Database rule 21: what a rolled piece gives). typical: the typical fighter's build file per realm 0-4. constants: fight.py constants (Combat Formulas B, Combat Defence & Healing A0-D) the compiler reads; lib_art_keys: the art fields a library art brings; build_defaults: an engine Build's fields before to_build() sets them; file_defaults: fight.py's literal defaults for a build file's missing fields.

aftershock-slam.name: Aftershock Slam (Dư Chấn Kích)
aftershock-slam.rule: Every heavy art you fire, this one included, counts a tremor. Each third tremor repeats the art that just fired at half strength.

ambush-talisman.name: Ambush Talisman (Phục Kích Phù)
ambush-talisman.rule: Lays a hidden talisman, up to 3: your next hit that lands springs them all, delaying the foe's slowest art 0.8 s and striking for a free Chaos hit each. Every seal you fire adds a Seal. With 3 Seals, an Exposed foe, or another seal fired the same pulse the talisman is a Snare that spends 2 Seals, strikes 3 times harder and exposes; the one after, with 4 Seals and either the foe at 50 % health or you at 40 % or less, is a Death Trap at 5 times that spends 4 Seals.

anchor-drop.name: Anchor Drop (Mao Trầm)
anchor-drop.rule: The anchor drops on its chain: the slowest, heaviest Physical hit of the common arts.

answering-palm.name: Answering Palm (Ứng Hưởng Chưởng)
answering-palm.rule: Every palm art you fire counts toward an echo; on the third your last art fires again at 60 % and the count resets. The palm itself falls plain, then as a Ringing Palm at 3.5 times, then as a Thousand Echo at 6 times that also repeats your last art whole, opened by echoes counted, three scripture arts within 2 s, a Slowed foe, four different arts in one pulse, or a Rolling Barrage Fist just fired.

answering-peal.name: Answering Peal (Hồi Lôi)
answering-peal.rule: Each crit, and each time the foe is newly Slowed, adds a Peal that lasts 8 s; at 3 Peals the next crit fires your last art again at 60 % and clears them. The Peal itself hits 3 times as hard with 3 Peals or three arts of its scripture fired in one pulse, and also 3 Thunder stacks on the foe or 2 on you.

ash-feather-gale.name: Ash-Feather Gale (Tro Vũ Cuồng Phong)
ash-feather-gale.rule: Counts as an Ashen Phoenix Canon art. A Fire gale that lays 3 Burn stacks for 6 s. Every Burn tick you deal blows a Cinder into the fan (twice a pulse at most). With 4 Cinders, and either 40 % of your health gone or another Ashen Phoenix art fired in the last 3 s, the fan unleashes the Ash-Feather Gale: four times as hard, spending the Cinders.

ash-of-the-effigy.name: Ash of the Effigy (Hình Nhân Tro)
ash-of-the-effigy.rule: When you are Silenced, cleanses 3 debuff batches from you; it has no element tag, so no Silence can name it.

ash-rebirth.name: Ash Rebirth (Tro Tàn Tái Sinh)
ash-rebirth.rule: A Fire hit that lays 3 Burn stacks. Every Burn tick you deal gathers Ash (no cap); once per fight, with 3 Ash or more, you refuse to go Down and rise healed for 3 % of your health per Ash. With 6 Ash or below 35 % health, and either 20 Burn on the foe or two Ashen Phoenix arts in 3 s, it becomes a Phoenix Pyre: five times the hit, 8 Burn stacks and a 10 % heal, spending 6 Ash.

backwash-seal.name: Backwash Seal (Hồi Lưu Ấn)
backwash-seal.rule: Every 3rd Water art you fire is followed by a backwash: the same art strikes again at half power and returns 2 % of your linh lực. Heavy arts make the best echoes.

banyan-shade.name: Banyan Shade (Dung Âm)
banyan-shade.rule: Heals on any scratch (health 95 % or less) and gives back its cost; healing past full feeds Surplus Life.

bark-mantle.name: Bark Mantle (Bì Giáp)
bark-mantle.rule: Raises a body shield of 15 % of your health and gives you 3 Wood stacks for 10 s.

bastion-reprisal.name: Bastion Reprisal (Bích Lũy Báo)
bastion-reprisal.rule: Raises a body shield of 12 % of your health; whenever a body shield of yours breaks it bursts into a free Physical hit of 2.5, 6 Earth stacks on the foe and 2 Strata. If the wall still stands (10 % of health) or you hold Mountain Stance the slam hits 3 times as hard, and spending 8 of your Earth stacks makes it a further 2.5 times.

bedrock-breath.name: Bedrock Breath (Nham Tức)
bedrock-breath.rule: No hit. Gives you 6 Earth buff stacks for 10 s. While you hold 6 or more Earth buff stacks you regain +0.5 pp health a pulse: endurance turns into recovery.

bell-of-waking.name: Bell of Waking (Tỉnh Hồn Chung)
bell-of-waking.rule: While your soul is slackened, cleanses 2 of your debuffs: the answer to a rival soul build.

binding-seal.name: Binding Seal (Phong Mạch Ấn)
binding-seal.rule: Applies Sealed Meridian: one named layer of the foe counts as 1.0 for 2 pulses.

binding-thrust.name: Binding Thrust (Phược Thích)
binding-thrust.rule: A Physical spear hit that lays Exposed (all resistance -100 points) for 3 pulses.

black-ice-glaze.name: Black Ice Glaze (Huyền Băng Ấn)
black-ice-glaze.rule: Hits and glazes the foe in black ice. Your next art, of any kind, lands on a brittle foe: Exposed (their resistances down 100), 8 Ice stacks for 6 s and a cold free hit. Glaze twice and two arts are blessed.

blade-mirror-trace-cut.name: Mirror-Trace Cut (Kính Ngấn Trảm)
blade-mirror-trace-cut.rule: A quick Metal cut that polishes the air into a mirror. A critical hit leaves 3 Afterimages.

blade-sword-rain.name: Sword Rain Descends (Kiếm Vũ Giáng)
blade-sword-rain.rule: Counts as an Afterimage Sword Canon art. A quick Metal cut that lays 1 Metal debuff stack for 6 s; each of its hits leaves an Afterimage (twice a pulse at most). With 5 Afterimages, and either two canon arts fired in the last 2 s or 3 Bleed on the foe, the sword calls the rain: it spends the Afterimages and becomes four cuts of 3 times the force.

blade-thousand-cut-return.name: Thousand-Cut Return (Thiên Trảm Hồi)
blade-thousand-cut-return.rule: A Metal cut that lays 3 Metal debuff stacks for 6 s; each hit leaves an Afterimage. With 15 Metal debuff stacks on the foe, and either 3 Afterimages or two Afterimage Sword Canon arts fired in the last second, the sword gathers every cut: it spends 10 of the stacks and falls 4 times as hard.

blade-thread-edge-cut.name: Thread-Edge Cut (Ti Nhận Trảm)
blade-thread-edge-cut.rule: A quick flying-sword cut that lays 1 Metal debuff stack for 6 s.

blade-twin-edge-return.name: Twin-Edge Return (Song Nhận Hồi)
blade-twin-edge-return.rule: A flying sword cuts out and back: a Metal hit that lays 1 Bleed stack. A critical hit lays 2 more Bleed stacks for 5 s.

bleeding-slash.name: Bleeding Slash (Xuất Huyết Trảm)
bleeding-slash.rule: A Physical saber hit that opens 1 Bleed stack.

blight-canker.name: Blight Canker (Hủ Căn)
blight-canker.rule: Hits, lays 2 Poison stacks for 8 s and 3 Stagnation. While the foe is stagnated, your Chaos ticks add more Stagnation (twice a pulse); at 10 Stagnation they also curse it with Withering. Fired into 6 Stagnation, or eating 15 Poison stacks, or after 3 canopy arts in a pulse, it hits four times as hard and drives the curse deeper.

blood-fed-pyre.name: Blood-Fed Pyre (Huyết Dưỡng Hỏa)
blood-fed-pyre.rule: Costs 5 % of your health besides a little linh lực. It deals 8 % more for every 10 % of health you are missing and returns 15 % of its damage as health.

blood-ink-writ.name: Blood-Ink Writ (Huyết Mặc Phù)
blood-ink-writ.rule: Written in your own blood: it costs 8 % of your health on top of its linh lực, and brands the foe with Withering and Stagnation. Every different status on the foe makes your seal arts 4 % stronger, with no limit.

blood-quench-blade.name: Blood-Quench Blade (Huyết Thối Nhận)
blood-quench-blade.rule: Costs 6 % of your health as well as linh lực, and gives you 5 Metal buff stacks (+1.2 % Physical damage dealt each) for 8 s. Each crit of this art heals you 2 % of your health and adds a Temper, so a keen edge repays the blood.

bloodletting-rite.name: Bloodletting Rite (Phóng Huyết Nghi)
bloodletting-rite.rule: Pays 4 % of your health on top of its linh lực cost for a heavy chaos hit that deals 1 % more for every 10 % of health you are missing. For the next 6 s every hit you land heals you for 2 % of the damage, so the cut is repaid if you keep striking.

bloodroot-pact.name: Bloodroot Pact (Huyết Căn Khế)
bloodroot-pact.rule: Costs 6 % of your health besides a little linh lực; hits and lays 3 Poison stacks for 10 s. Once a pulse a Chaos tick you deal heals you for 0.2 % of your health for every 10 Poison stacks on the foe, and fired into 15 Poison stacks the pact repays the blood in full.

body-bone-splitting-chop.name: Bone-Splitting Chop (Phách Cốt Trảm)
body-bone-splitting-chop.rule: A slow heavy chop with a butcher's axe. Each chop writes 1 Debt and hardens a little body shield, feeding the Unbroken Flesh arts.

body-flesh-seal-slam.name: Flesh-Seal Slam (Nhục Ấn Áp)
body-flesh-seal-slam.rule: Counts as an Unbroken Flesh Canon art. A heavy seal slam that writes 2 Debt and hardens a body shield worth 5 % of your health. With 4 Debt and a body shield of 20 % of your health held, the seal presses down as the Flesh Seal: 3.5 times as hard, spending the Debt.

body-pledge-drop.name: Pledge Drop (Thệ Cốt Trầm)
body-pledge-drop.rule: Counts as an Unbroken Flesh Canon art. An anchor dropped on a pledge of 6 % of your health: it writes 3 Debt and hardens a little body shield without taking a single hit. With 4 Debt the pledge is called in: 3 times as hard, spending the Debt.

body-splitting-the-mountain.name: Splitting the Mountain (Phích Sơn)
body-splitting-the-mountain.rule: A slow axe blow that deals 5 % more for every 5 % of health held as body shield, and winds 1 Debt for each hit you take (once a pulse). With 5 Debt, and either Mountain Root held or a body shield of 30 % of your health, the axe splits the mountain: 4.5 times as hard, spending the Debt.

bone-turning-palm.name: Bone-Turning Palm (Chuyển Cốt Chưởng)
bone-turning-palm.rule: A heavy palm whose force passes through the body: half of the blow lands as Force and meets the foe's Force defence instead of its Physical one, and it leaves a Qi Disruption. It counts as a palm art for any echo.

branding-seal.name: Branding Seal (Lạc Ấn)
branding-seal.rule: A heavy seal strike of which 40 % is turned into Soul damage, passing wards and body. With 2 Seals and either 2 Slackened Soul on the foe, the foe at 50 % health or less, or another ledger seal fired the same pulse, the brand is Sunk to the Soul: 3 times the force, entirely Soul, and it spends 2 Seals.

brazier-form.name: Brazier Form (Lô Hỏa Thế)
brazier-form.rule: Toggles Brazier Form: 15 % more damage, 8 % less damage taken and 15 % slower arts, but Ember Rain is suppressed. In the form every hit you take lays 2 Burn stacks on the attacker, and each Burn tick you deal mends you a little.

brimming-cup.name: Brimming Cup (Doanh Bôi)
brimming-cup.rule: Restores 10 % linh lực, raises a body shield of 10 % health and gives 2 Water stacks; overflowing linh lực spills as a free hit and a broken shield bursts and heals 3 %. Fired again with 2 Tide while nearly full of linh lực or in the Deep Lake, it overflows as a hit; fired a third time with 3 Tide and a shield standing or half health it crashes down and renews the shield.

bulwark-knuckle.name: Bulwark Knuckle (Thuẫn Quyền)
bulwark-knuckle.rule: A fist that raises a body shield worth 12 % of your health and hits 6 % harder for every 4 % of health held as shield; a broken shield bursts for a free Force hit and winds the Ram. Hits taken behind a shield also wind the Ram; the next firings are a Slam at 3.5 times, then a Rampart Collapse at 10 times as Force, which needs a 30 % shield plus 5 Ram, Mountain Root, or three canon arts within 2 s.

burning-reply.name: Burning Reply (Hỏa Báo)
burning-reply.rule: Gives you 4 Fire buff stacks for 10 s. While equipped, every hit you take stokes 1 more Fire buff stack for 6 s (at most 3 a pulse): pain turned into damage.

capacitor-palm.name: Capacitor Palm (Tụ Lôi Chưởng)
capacitor-palm.rule: Every Lightning art that lands, and every crit (twice a pulse at most), stores a Charge with no cap; firing the Palm releases each Charge as a 0.15 lightning strike and empties the store. With 3 Charges or Overload Form up it hits 1.6 times as hard, and the firing after that, with 6 Charges and either 6 Thunder stacks on the foe or three arts of its scripture fired in one pulse, burns 3 of your Thunder stacks to hit 4 times as hard.

chaff-needle.name: Chaff Needle (Khang Châm)
chaff-needle.rule: A quick physical hit that grants you 1 Wind stack (+7.5 % art speed) for 4 s.

chain-arc.name: Chain Arc (Liên Hoàn Lôi)
chain-arc.rule: Strikes five times in a row, each hit rolling its own crit; every crit raises your crit chance by 6 for 3 s, stacking. With 4 Thunder stacks on you or the foe, or Overload Form up, it hits 1.6 times as hard, and the firing after that, with 2 Thunder stacks on you or 4 on the foe and also 3 Peals, 4 Charges or three arts of its scripture fired in one pulse, burns 2 of your Thunder stacks to strike 8 times at 2.5 times the strength.

chain-sword.name: Chain Sword (Liên Hoàn Kiếm)
chain-sword.rule: A Physical sword hit; whenever it crits (at most 2 times a pulse) your other arts' timers run 0.5 s shorter. Crits chain the whole kit.

chaos-bolt.name: Chaos Bolt (Hỗn Độn Tiễn)
chaos-bolt.rule: A plain chaos bolt: only Chaos or all resistance cuts it.

cinder-cloak.name: Cinder Cloak (Tẫn Y)
cinder-cloak.rule: Raises a body shield of 10 % of your health; each hit you take lays 1 Burn stack for 6 s on the attacker.

closing-palm.name: Closing Palm (Hợp Chưởng)
closing-palm.rule: A Physical palm hit that lays 3 Metal debuff stacks for 10 s.

cloud-splitting-bolt.name: Cloud-Splitting Bolt (Phá Vân Lôi)
cloud-splitting-bolt.rule: The largest bolt of a volley, so a drain ward spends its pool on it first; when it crits it lays 4 Thunder debuff stacks for 6 s.

coiling-thrust.name: Coiling Thrust (Triền Thương Đột)
coiling-thrust.rule: Every spear or bow art of this canon you fire adds a Coil, with no cap. With 4 Coils, 3 Slowed Time on the foe, or two canon arts fired in one pulse the thrust spends 4 Coils and hits 2.2 times as hard; the thrust after that needs 6 Coils and either 4 Slowed Time or a Nocked Arrow loosed within 3 s; it spends 6 Coils and becomes five thrusts of 3.5 times the force that lay Exposed.

coin-shot.name: Coin Shot (Tiền Tiêu Kích)
coin-shot.rule: A flicked coin: a cheap, quick Physical hit with the Metal tag.

cold-ledger.name: Cold Ledger (Hàn Trướng)
cold-ledger.rule: No damage: lays 3 Ice stacks for 12 s on the foe.

deaf-verdict.name: Deaf Verdict (Tuyệt Thính Phán)
deaf-verdict.rule: A soul hit that fires only against a boss.

debt-blade.name: Debt Blade (Huyết Trái Kiếm)
debt-blade.rule: Costs 5 % of your health as well as a little linh lực. After it hits, it strikes again for every 15 % of health you are missing, with no cap.

deep-lake-stance.name: Deep Lake Stance (Thâm Hồ Thế)
deep-lake-stance.rule: Firing it enters or leaves the Deep Lake: inside you regenerate and heal faster, gain a Water stack and a Tide every pulse, and deal 30 % less damage. Leaving the lake with 6 Water stacks, 4 Tide or half health or less lets it flow out: one big hit, a free hit per Water stack spent, and a 5 % heal.

deep-winter-form.name: Deep Winter Form (Thâm Đông Thế)
deep-winter-form.rule: Firing it enters or leaves the Deep Winter: inside you cast 20 % slower and resist 20 points more, every hit you land (basic attacks too) lays 2 Ice stacks for 8 s, and you gain a Frost each pulse. Leaving with 5 Frost, 15 Ice stacks on the foe or half health or less is a thaw break: one big cold hit and 10 more Ice stacks.

delaying-gong.name: Delaying Gong (Hoãn Chung)
delaying-gong.rule: A hit that pushes back all the foe's art timers by 1 s (falling off with repeats and the foe's timer resistance).

drag-of-the-deep.name: Drag of the Deep (Thâm Uyên Kéo)
drag-of-the-deep.rule: Hits, adds Slowed Time and delays the foe's slowest-ready art by 1 s; each Slowed Time stack on the foe returns a little linh lực. Fired again while the foe has 3 Slowed Time, is nearly dry, or after two arts of its litany this pulse, it undertows (bigger hit, longer delay); a third firing against 5 Slowed Time and two litany arts this pulse spends your Water stacks for linh lực and delays every art.

dragging-moment.name: Dragging Moment (Duyên Thời)
dragging-moment.rule: Applies Slowed Time ×2: the foe's arts and basic attack run 12 % slower for 3 pulses.

drawing-breath.name: Drawing Breath (Hấp Triều)
drawing-breath.rule: Restores 7 % of your linh lực and gives you 2 Water stacks for 15 s.

drowning-palm.name: Drowning Palm (Nịch Thủy Chưởng)
drowning-palm.rule: A force palm that burns the foe's linh lực (Qi Disruption x3); it fires only while their pool has water (5 % or more).

earth-mooring-drop.name: Mooring Drop (Mao Trầm Địa)
earth-mooring-drop.rule: Counts as a Mountain Heart Canon art. The anchor drops as a Physical hit and lays 2 Strata. With 5 Strata, and the foe Slowed 2 deep, Mountain Stance, or two canon arts fired in the last 4 s, it moors the foe: spends 5 Strata for a hit 2.8 times as hard, 2 Slowed Time and a 1.5 s delay on every foe art.

earth-mountain-presses-sky.name: Mountain Presses the Sky (Sơn Áp Thiên)
earth-mountain-presses-sky.rule: Counts as a Deep Vein Scripture art. A slow heavy Earth seal that lays 4 Earth stacks for 6 s. With 10 Earth stacks on the foe, and either three deep-vein arts fired in 8 s or the foe Slowed 3 deep, it presses the mountain down: spends 10 stacks for a hit 4.2 times as hard that Sunders and adds 2 Slowed Time.

earth-pick-fall.name: Pick Fall (Thạch Phủ Trụy)
earth-pick-fall.rule: One heavy overhead stroke: an Earth hit that lays 2 Earth stacks for 6 s. It is a heavy art, so Aftershock Slam counts it.

earth-sand-needle-prick.name: Sand Needle Prick (Sa Châm Thích)
earth-sand-needle-prick.rule: A needle of packed sand: an Earth hit that lays 3 Earth stacks for 6 s. With 6 Earth stacks on the foe, it spends them for a hit twice as hard that adds 1 Slowed Time for 4 s.

ebb-and-flow.name: Ebb and Flow (Triều Tịch)
ebb-and-flow.rule: Heals a little; every time you are healed you gain 2 Water stacks for 10 s (once a pulse), so healing feeds Water and Water feeds healing.

echo-of-the-dodge.name: Echo of the Dodge (Hồi Phong Ảnh)
echo-of-the-dodge.rule: Every evade and every crit counts an Echo, with no cap. Firing this art replays your previous art once for each Echo, each at 25 % strength, and spends them. It hits 3.5 times as hard with 3 Echoes and also a Slowed foe or Swallow Stance up.

ember-rain.name: Ember Rain (Tàn Hỏa Vũ)
ember-rain.rule: A fast Fire hit that lays 20 Burn stacks for 2 s: the front-loaded clock of a Burn build.

exposing-thread.name: Exposing Thread (Hiển Tuyến)
exposing-thread.rule: A chaos hit that applies Exposed: −100 points of all resistance for 3 pulses.

falling-leaf.name: Falling Leaf (Điệp Lạc)
falling-leaf.rule: A heavier wind cut with a longer cooldown that grants 1 Wind stack for 8 s.

fan-gust.name: Fan Gust (Phiến Phong)
fan-gust.rule: One sweep of the fan: a plain Physical hit.

fanning-embers.name: Fanning Embers (Quạt Tàn Hỏa)
fanning-embers.rule: One sweep of burning wind: a quick Fire hit that lays 2 Burn stacks for 6 s.

far-flash.name: Far Flash (Viễn Thiểm)
far-flash.rule: The herald: lays 4 Thunder debuff stacks for 6 s; each crit against a foe already marked lays 1 more.

feed-the-fire.name: Feed the Fire (Đầu Hỏa)
feed-the-fire.rule: No hit. Only while your linh lực is at 40 % or more: gives you 12 Fire buff stacks for 5 s, so spending linh lực turns directly into damage dealt.

flame-lance.name: Flame Lance (Liệt Diễm Thương)
flame-lance.rule: A slow Fire hit that lays 4 Burn stacks for 8 s.

flare-up.name: Flare Up (Bạo Diễm)
flare-up.rule: A Fire hit that burns off up to 20 Burn stacks on the foe; each stack consumed deals a Fire free hit of 0.12. The payoff for a Burn build.

flint-volley.name: Flint Volley (Đả Thạch Liên Hỏa)
flint-volley.rule: Holds 3 charges: each firing is a Fire hit that lays 2 Burn stacks for 6 s, and a spent charge refires after the minimum cooldown. Every quick Fire art you fire quickens all your arts by 4 % for 3 s, stacking. With 6 Fire buff stacks or 15 Burn on the foe, and another Red Sun art fired in the last 3 s, the firing becomes a Flashfire: four hits at nine tenths strength, spending up to 6 of your Fire buff stacks.

flurry-stance.name: Flurry Stance (Loạn Đao Thế)
flurry-stance.rule: Firing it enters Flurry, firing it again leaves it. In Flurry your basic attack is 25 % faster, hits a tenth harder and returns linh lực, but your plain sword and broad saber arts are suppressed.

flying-blade-retinue.name: Flying Blade Retinue (Phi Nhận Trận)
flying-blade-retinue.rule: Sends a flying sword that strikes every 2 s for 12 s; each firing adds another, with no cap on how many fly, and every blade hit lays a Metal debuff stack on the foe for 6 s. With 4 Metal stacks on the foe it breaks up to 12 of them, each 3 broken launching one more blade, and the firing hits 3 times as hard; the same blow lands without breaking if the foe is Sundered twice and you fired another art of this canon within 4 s or hold 8 Metal buff stacks.

flying-sword.name: Flying Sword (Phi Kiếm)
flying-sword.rule: Strikes once, then sends out a flying sword that hits every 1.5 s for 12 s; each firing adds another sword with no cap, and sword hits leave Afterimages. With 3 Afterimages and either three canon arts in one pulse, 4 Bleed on the foe, or 10 s since the last firing, the strike hits 2.8 times as hard and sends out 2 extra swords.

flying-sword-strike.name: Flying Sword Strike (Phi Kiếm Trảm)
flying-sword-strike.rule: The sword leaves the hand and cuts: a plain quick Physical hit.

force-chaos-foreclose.name: Foreclose (Tịch Biên)
force-chaos-foreclose.rule: Counts as a Ruin Ledger Scripture art. A slow Chaos seal that lays 1 Sundered. Every status or stack batch you land adds a Fray for 12 s. With 4 Fray it spends them and forecloses: 2.4 times as hard; a foe wearing 4 different statuses takes 1.2 times.

force-chaos-resonant-shockwave.name: Resonant Shockwave (Cộng Chấn Ba)
force-chaos-resonant-shockwave.rule: Counts as a Hollow Tide Scripture art. A quick Force wave that lays 1 Qi Disruption. Each Force burn tick you deal adds a Drink (once a pulse), so the zither feeds the scripture's Draining Gulp and Hollowing Strike.

force-chaos-settle-the-account.name: Settle the Account (Kết Toán)
force-chaos-settle-the-account.rule: Counts as a Ruin Ledger Scripture art. A slow Chaos seal that lays 1 Stagnation. Every status or stack batch you land adds a Fray for 12 s. With 5 Fray it spends them and the account is settled: 4.5 times as hard; a foe wearing 4 different statuses takes 3 times, and so does one hit by Ripening Curse in the last 4 s (2.8 times).

forked-light.name: Forked Light (Xoa Điện)
forked-light.rule: A cheap lightning hit that lands after your bigger bolts and costs little.

forking-verdict.name: Forking Verdict (Phân Lôi Phán)
forking-verdict.rule: Each crit with it forks into a free lightning hit of 0.6 coefficient, up to 2 a pulse.

fraying-thread.name: Fraying Thread (Tơ Rã)
fraying-thread.rule: A chaos thread that lays Sundered. Every status or stack batch you land adds a Fray for 12 s, with no cap. With 6 Fray it spends them and tears the foe for 3 times the force; a foe wearing 3 different statuses takes 1.8 times, and 3 Fray spent when you fired another art of this scripture the same pulse tear for 3.5 times.

frostbound-toll.name: Frostbound Toll (Hàn Toán Tỏa)
frostbound-toll.rule: Hits; if the foe holds 20 or more Ice stacks, it also curses them with Heavy Breath (art costs up 25 %). Ice stacked high locks the whole kit.

frozen-hour-seal.name: Frozen Hour Seal (Đình Thời Ấn)
frozen-hour-seal.rule: A seal hit that lays 2 Slowed Time, and every Slowed Time stack on the foe brings each of your other arts 0.25 s closer to ready. If you hold 2 Seals and the foe holds Slowed Time, the Ambush Talisman was set in the last 3 s, or you hold 4 Seals, the seal becomes the Hour Stopped: 2.5 times the force, 3 more Slowed Time, 3 Seals spent and all your other arts 1 s closer.

frozen-marrow-pact.name: Frozen Marrow Pact (Cốt Băng Khế)
frozen-marrow-pact.rule: Pay 6 % of your health along with a little linh lực to strike. For every 5 Ice stacks on the foe it adds a cold free hit and heals you 1 %, so the colder they are the more the pact gives back.

furnace-heart.name: Furnace Heart (Lô Tâm Tích Nhiệt)
furnace-heart.rule: Every Fire hit you land builds 1 Heat and this art builds 3 (no cap; Heat fades slowly), and each Heat adds 1 % more Fire damage. When you have 4 Heat and either the foe has 15 Burn stacks or you fired two arts of the Red Sun Scripture within 3 s, this art vents: it hits two and a half times as hard, burns off up to 60 Burn stacks as Fire free hits (each stack burnt is one more free hit, no cap) and spends 4 Heat.

gale-crown.name: Gale Crown (Cuồng Phong Quán)
gale-crown.rule: A heavy wind hit that grants 3 Wind stacks for 10 s.

gale-sprite.name: Gale Sprite (Phong Linh Đồng)
gale-sprite.rule: Calls a sprite for 12 s that strikes for 0.45 each second. Every 2 Wind buff stacks you hold make it strike 8 % faster, and each evade makes it 15 % faster for 3 s.

gale-veil.name: Gale Veil (Phong Mạc)
gale-veil.rule: Gives you 3 Wind stacks for 10 s and +10 evade for 6 s.

gate-hammer.name: Gate Hammer (Quan Chùy)
gate-hammer.rule: A heavy Earth slam that lays 4 Earth debuff stacks for 6 s on the foe.

gathered-ruin-verdict.name: Gathered Ruin Verdict (Tụ Phế Phán)
gathered-ruin-verdict.rule: Each status or stack batch you land banks 3 % damage more for your next art, up to 5 times, and the next art spends it; the Verdict itself lays Exposed. It becomes a Final Verdict of 4 times the force when it spends 4 Fray, 3.5 times when the foe wears 4 different statuses or you cast Ripening Curse within 4 s.

gathering-wave.name: Gathering Wave (Tụ Ba)
gathering-wave.rule: Banks a wave (up to 4); your next art or basic hit that lands releases every banked wave as a free Water hit and heals you 2 % per wave. With 2 Tide and either the Deep Lake or 2 Slowed Time on the foe, or 3 Tide (spent) at 70 % health or less, the wave instead crests: it strikes at once for a big hit and banks a surge of two more waves.

general-last-coin-flick.name: Last Coin Flick (Tuyệt Tiền Kích)
general-last-coin-flick.rule: A flicked coin: a quick Physical hit. With 40 % of your health gone it is the last coin in the purse, and flies four times as hard.

general-threading-rain.name: Threading Rain (Xuyên Châm Vũ)
general-threading-rain.rule: A cheap, quick Physical volley. With half your health gone it threads a second pass, 1.6 times as hard.

general-wayfarer-cut.name: Wayfarer's Cut (Hành Lữ Trảm)
general-wayfarer-cut.rule: A plain quick Physical cut that carries no element, so it never fights a build's own.

gourd-spout.name: Gourd Spout (Hồ Lô Phún)
gourd-spout.rule: The gourd spits what it holds: a plain Physical hit.

gourd-swallows-flame.name: Gourd Swallows the Flame (Hồ Lô Thôn Diễm)
gourd-swallows-flame.rule: The gourd drinks the flames on the foe: a Fire hit. With 10 Burn stacks or more on the foe, it swallows 5 of them and spits them back as a hit 2.2 times as hard.

green-poultice.name: Green Poultice (Thanh Cao)
green-poultice.rule: At 70 % health or less: heals, gives back its cost and cleanses 1 of your debuffs.

haft-sweep.name: Haft Sweep (Côn Tảo)
haft-sweep.rule: A Physical spear hit that delays the foe's art timers by 0.5 s (once a pulse); delays fall off.

harvest-bloom.name: Harvest Bloom (Thu Hoạch Khai Hoa)
harvest-bloom.rule: A heavy Wood hit that lays 2 Poison stacks for 8 s. With 12 Poison stacks on the foe it harvests them, every 2 blooming as a Chaos hit and a heal; or it spends 4 Seeds, or 10 of your own Wood stacks (every 5 blooming as a Chaos hit). Any harvest hits four times as hard and ripples once more.

heart-lamp-lance.name: Heart-Lamp Lance (Tâm Đăng Thương)
heart-lamp-lance.rule: The biggest soul hit, a lance for a soul already slackened.

hearth-mending.name: Hearth Mending (Noãn Dưỡng)
hearth-mending.rule: At 75 % health or less: heals, and each heal gives you 3 Fire stacks for 8 s.

heartwood-spear.name: Heartwood Spear (Tâm Mộc Thương)
heartwood-spear.rule: A heavy wood spear; for every 10 Poison stacks on the foe it follows with an extra chaos hit.

heat-haze.name: Heat Haze (Nhiệt Phù Chướng)
heat-haze.rule: A Fire hit that lays 3 Burn stacks for 6 s and 1 Slowed Time. While the foe carries 25 Burn stacks or more, each Burn tick adds another Slowed Time (at most once a pulse). With 25 Burn on the foe, or a foe low on linh lực, or 2 Slowed Time on it, or another Ashen Phoenix art fired in the last 3 s, it becomes a Stifling Heat: three and a half times the hit, 2 more Slowed Time, and up to 25 Burn stacks are burnt off to delay everything the foe has.

heavy-breath-mark.name: Heavy Breath Mark (Trọng Tức Ấn)
heavy-breath-mark.rule: Applies Heavy Breath: the foe's art cost rises 25 % per stack, up to 2 stacks.

held-breath.name: Held Breath (Bế Tức Phong)
held-breath.rule: Each evade banks a Breath (up to 10): your next art fired, any art, spends them all as one 0.2 hit and 1 Wind stack for 4 s per Breath (Breath is only counted out when Held Breath itself fires). Held Breath hits 3.5 times as hard with 2 Breath counted and also Swallow Stance, a Slowed foe, 3 Wind stacks or three courier arts fired in one pulse.

hollow-husk-stance.name: Hollow Husk Stance (Không Xác Thế)
hollow-husk-stance.rule: Toggles a stance: your basic attack hits 0.8 harder and 30 % faster and every basic hit lays 1 Qi Disruption, but every art costs 35 % more linh lực. Fire it again to drop the stance.

hollow-step.name: Hollow Step (Hư Bộ)
hollow-step.rule: A small wind hit that grants 2 Wind stacks for 8 s and returns 2 % of your maximum linh lực.

hollowing-strike.name: Hollowing Strike (Khoét Rỗng Kích)
hollowing-strike.rule: A heavy force fist that lays 1 Qi Disruption. Against a foe wearing Disruption it hits 2.2 times as hard. Against a foe below 40 % linh lực while you spend 3 Drink, it is a Hollowing Blow: 3.5 times the force, and it returns 10 % of your linh lực.

hundred-feather-flurry.name: Hundred-Feather Flurry (Bách Vũ Loạn Phong)
hundred-feather-flurry.rule: Every basic attack that lands, and every evade (twice a pulse at most), gathers a Feather with no cap; firing the art releases one 0.1-strength hit per Feather and spends them. Fired with 5 Feathers or in Swallow Stance it hits 2 times as hard, and the firing after that, with 8 Feathers and also a Slowed foe, Swallow Stance or three courier arts fired in one pulse, burns 3 of your Wind stacks (a 0.4 hit for each one burned) to hit 3.5 times as hard.

ice-breaking-peal.name: Ice-Breaking Peal (Phá Lăng Lôi)
ice-breaking-peal.rule: The slowest, heaviest peal a thunder build can slot; it hits 30 % harder (damage more) when the foe's linh lực is dry.

ice-frost-tithe-gust.name: Frost-Tithe Gust (Sương Thuế Phong)
ice-frost-tithe-gust.rule: A cold gust that lays 2 Ice stacks for 8 s. With 8 Ice stacks on the foe it eats 4 of them, hits twice as hard and delays the foe's slowest art by 0.5 s.

ice-hoarfrost-prick.name: Hoarfrost Prick (Sương Châm Thích)
ice-hoarfrost-prick.rule: A needle of frost: a quick Cold hit that lays 1 Ice stack for 8 s.

ice-moon-stills-tide.name: Moon Stills the Tide (Nguyệt Đình Triều)
ice-moon-stills-tide.rule: Counts as a Stilled Hour Sutra art. A cold sword stroke that lays 2 Ice stacks for 8 s and 1 Slowed Time. With 10 Ice stacks on the foe, and either 2 Slowed Time or two Sutra arts fired this pulse, the moon stills the tide: it eats 6 stacks, hits three and a half times as hard, delays the foe's slowest art by 0.5 s and lays a further Slowed Time for 5 s.

ice-stilled-thread-prick.name: Stilled Thread Prick (Đình Tuyến Thích)
ice-stilled-thread-prick.rule: A needle that stitches the moment still: a quick Cold hit that lays 1 Ice stack for 8 s and 1 Slowed Time for 4 s.

ice-toll-stamp.name: Toll Stamp (Toán Ấn Áp)
ice-toll-stamp.rule: Counts as a Winter Toll Canon art. A slow cold seal that lays 3 Ice stacks for 8 s and adds a Frost. With 10 Ice stacks on the foe, and either 2 Frost or another Winter Toll art fired in the last 3 s, it eats 5 stacks and 2 Frost and falls two and a half times as hard.

iron-fist.name: Iron Fist (Thiết Quyền)
iron-fist.rule: A fast, cheap Physical fist hit.

iron-hide-stance.name: Iron Hide Stance (Thiết Bì Thế)
iron-hide-stance.rule: Firing it enters or leaves the Iron Hide stance: +120 resistance and +35 block, and Shatter-Edge Cleave is suppressed. While in it, each hit you take gives you a Metal buff stack (+1.2 % Physical damage dealt) for 8 s.

iron-mountain-shield.name: Iron Mountain Shield (Thiết Sơn Thuẫn)
iron-mountain-shield.rule: No hit. Raises a body shield of 8 % of your health.

iron-nail.name: Iron Nail (Thiết Đinh)
iron-nail.rule: Fires only while the foe bears Exposed. The main damage of a curse build: the hit that waits for the board to fill.

iron-spark.name: Iron Spark (Thiết Tinh)
iron-spark.rule: A physical hit that keeps the lightning tag for modifiers, so Lightning resistance does not stop it.

kindle-palm.name: Kindle Palm (Dẫn Hỏa Chưởng)
kindle-palm.rule: A Fire hit that lays 2 Burn stacks for 8 s.

lamp-oil-lance.name: Lamp-Oil Lance (Đăng Du Thương)
lamp-oil-lance.rule: Paid in divine sense (thần thức) instead of linh lực. It loosens the foe's soul, and every soul hit returns 2 % linh lực per Slackened Soul stack on the foe. If the foe is already slackened to 2, is dry of linh lực, you hold 4 Tolls, or the Bell rang in the last 2 s, the lance is Fully Lit: an extra heavy soul strike, 8 % linh lực back and a further slackening.

lamp-threading-needle.name: Lamp-Threading Needle (Xuyên Đăng Châm)
lamp-threading-needle.rule: A soul hit that applies Slackened Soul ×2 (−15 pp soul resistance each) so the next soul hit lands on a loosened soul.

landslide.name: Landslide (Băng Nham)
landslide.rule: A heavy Earth hit that also gives you 4 Earth buff stacks for 10 s.

lantern-out.name: Lantern Out (Đăng Tắt)
lantern-out.rule: Escape, usable only when your health is at or below 30 %.

last-breath-fist.name: Last Breath Fist (Tàn Tức Quyền)
last-breath-fist.rule: A heavy fist that deals 7 % more for every 10 % of health you are missing. It falls plain, then as a Rattling Breath at 3 times, then as the Last Breath at 6 times that Exposes the foe; each step opens on low health or on Debt from Marrow Tithe, and the last also on three canon arts within 2 s.

last-stitch.name: Last Stitch (Mạt Tuyến)
last-stitch.rule: Fires only while the foe's health is below 35 %. A Physical hit that passes 10 % of the foe's ward: the finishing stitch.

leaking-seal.name: Leaking Seal (Lậu Ấn)
leaking-seal.rule: Hits and curses the foe so their drain wards bill 50 % more; it fires only while their pool has water.

ledger-reckoning.name: Ledger Reckoning (Tính Sổ)
ledger-reckoning.rule: A Physical hit that deals more for every different status the foe bears: +4 points of L5 each. The payoff for a status collector.

lightning-step.name: Lightning Step (Lôi Độn)
lightning-step.rule: Escape, usable only when your health is at or below 30 %.

lustral-bell.name: Lustral Bell (Tẩy Chung)
lustral-bell.rule: Strikes a bell that cleanses 3 of your debuffs and strips 10 stacks from the foe.

lustral-toll.name: Lustral Toll (Tẩy Chung)
lustral-toll.rule: A slow hit that strips 5 of the foe's buff stacks and gives them to you with the time they had left.

marching-dirge.name: Marching Dirge (Hành Quân Khúc)
marching-dirge.rule: Playing it starts the march: your arts and basic attack run 20 % faster but cost 20 % more, and each pulse adds a Measure. Playing it again ends the march in a finale of one free hit for every Measure, with no limit.

marrow-siphon-palm.name: Marrow-Siphon Palm (Tủy Hấp Chưởng)
marrow-siphon-palm.rule: A force palm that lays 1 Qi Disruption, which burns the foe's linh lực each pulse; half of every point burned returns to you, and each burn tick adds a Drink for 10 s. Fired in a row, the palm becomes a Gulping Palm (1.5 times the force, one more Disruption) when you fired another art of this scripture the same pulse, the foe has 3 Disruption, or you hold the Husk stance, and then a Draining Gulp (4 times the force, returns 8 % of your linh lực) when you spend 8 Drink or the foe is below 35 % linh lực.

marrow-tithe-strike.name: Marrow Tithe Strike (Tủy Cống Quyền)
marrow-tithe-strike.rule: A body fist that pays 8 % of your health for a small strike and 15 % of your linh lực; each firing writes 2 Debt (and every hit you take 1, once a pulse), cheapens your arts 40 % for 5 s and hardens a little body shield. The next two firings call the Debt in, as a Marrow Burst at 4 times and a Last Marrow at 11 times that refills your linh lực, each opened by 4 Debt, low health, or three canon arts fired within 2 s.

marrow-to-dew.name: Marrow to Dew (Tủy Hóa Lộ)
marrow-to-dew.rule: Pay 5 % of your health, not linh lực, to restore 20 % linh lực and gain 2 Water stacks; for every 10 % of health you are missing it returns 3 % more. Every heal afterwards also returns 1.5 % linh lực (once a pulse).

mending-breath.name: Mending Breath (Hồi Khí Tức)
mending-breath.rule: At 60 % health or less: heals and gives back its cost.

metal-black-nail-prick.name: Black-Nail Prick (Hắc Đinh Thích)
metal-black-nail-prick.rule: A quick Physical needle that lays 1 Sundered for 6 s.

metal-copper-flick.name: Copper Flick (Đồng Tiền Đạn Chỉ)
metal-copper-flick.rule: A flicked coin: a quick Physical hit that lays 1 Metal debuff stack for 6 s.

metal-earthbind-drop.name: Earthbind Drop (Phược Địa Trầm)
metal-earthbind-drop.rule: A hooked anchor dropped on the foe: a Physical hit that lays 2 Earth debuff stacks for 8 s.

metal-golden-coin-rain.name: Golden Coin Rain (Kim Tiền Vũ)
metal-golden-coin-rain.rule: A quick Physical coin that lays 2 Metal debuff stacks for 6 s. With 8 Metal stacks on the foe or 5 Temper, it breaks up to 8 stacks (each 2 broken a free 0.4 hit) and falls 3 times as hard.

metal-hundred-edge-flight.name: Hundred-Edge Flight (Bách Nhận Phi Hành)
metal-hundred-edge-flight.rule: Counts as a Hundred-Blades Canon art. A quick Physical sword hit that lays a Metal debuff stack for 6 s. With 6 Metal stacks on the foe and either another canon art fired in the last 4 s or 4 Temper, it breaks up to 6 stacks (each 3 broken a free 0.5 hit) and hits 2.5 times as hard.

metal-splitting-chop.name: Splitting Chop (Phách Liệt Phủ)
metal-splitting-chop.rule: A heavy Physical chop that lays 2 Bleed for 6 s. With 6 Metal stacks on the foe it splits them (breaking 6) and falls 1.8 times as hard.

millstone-palm.name: Millstone Palm (Ma Thạch Chưởng)
millstone-palm.rule: Half of this Earth hit lands as Physical, meeting body defences instead, and it lays 2 Earth stacks and a Bleed. Every 4 Earth stacks on the foe grind a further Bleed into it on each landing.

mind-thorn.name: Mind Thorn (Tâm Thích)
mind-thorn.rule: A plain soul hit, set against the foe's soul resistance.

mountain-cleave.name: Mountain Cleave (Khai Sơn Phủ)
mountain-cleave.rule: The axe comes down once: a slow, heavy Physical hit.

mountain-press-seal.name: Mountain-Press Seal (Áp Sơn Ấn)
mountain-press-seal.rule: A heavy Physical hit. If the foe bears 4 or more of your Earth debuff stacks it lands a further free Physical hit of 0.8; Tremor Palm and Gate Hammer prepare it.

mountain-root-stance.name: Mountain Root Stance (Sơn Căn Thế)
mountain-root-stance.rule: Toggles Mountain Root: 20 % less damage taken, +15 block and a little health regeneration, but your arts are 20 % slower and Rolling Barrage Fist is suppressed. In the form every hit you take strikes back (twice a pulse at most), and each 5 % of health held as body shield adds 4 resistance.

mountain-splitting-thought.name: Mountain-Splitting Thought (Phá Sơn Niệm)
mountain-splitting-thought.rule: A middle soul hit that fills the gap between a needle and a lance.

mountain-stance.name: Mountain Stance (Trấn Sơn Thế)
mountain-stance.rule: Toggles a stance: you strike and cast slower and take less damage, and every hit you take adds an Earth stack for 12 s and a Stratum, and is answered by a free Physical hit of 0.6 (once every 3 s). Firing it again leaves the stance.

needle-rain.name: Needle Rain (Châm Vũ)
needle-rain.rule: Throws 6 needles of a fifth of the hit each, and every needle rolls its own crit and lays Bleed. Each crit needle also lays a Metal debuff stack (+1.8 % Physical damage taken) for 8 s.

ninth-weight-lance.name: Ninth-Weight Lance (Cửu Quân Thương)
ninth-weight-lance.rule: The heaviest soul hit: 6.4 % of the foe's soul bar.

nocked-arrow.name: Nocked Arrow (Nhập Huyền Tiễn)
nocked-arrow.rule: Every hit and every crit leaves a nocked arrow, up to 4, that flies as a free hit with the next art you fire; the arrow from this art also lays Slowed Time. Fired with 2 Slowed Time on the foe, 3 Coils, or two canon arts in one pulse it hits 1.8 times as hard; the firing after that needs 4 Coils and either 7 s of patience, a foe at 35 % health or less, or 4 Slowed Time, and is a Volley of four arrows at 3 times the force.

notch-the-foe.name: Notch the Foe (Khắc Ngân)
notch-the-foe.rule: A Physical sword hit that lays 3 Metal debuff stacks (+1.8 % Physical damage taken each) for 8 s.

overload-form.name: Overload Form (Quá Tải Thể)
overload-form.rule: Firing it toggles Overload: +25 % art speed and +15 crit chance but -25 evade, and each crit gives you 1 Thunder buff stack and a small lightning backlash. It ends when you toggle it again or your linh lực falls to 15 %.

packed-earth-stance.name: Packed Earth Stance (Hậu Thổ Trụ Thế)
packed-earth-stance.rule: No hit. Gives you 5 Earth buff stacks for 12 s (Physical damage taken 1.1 % dampened each).

peg-line-cut.name: Peg-Line Cut (Đinh Tuyến Trảm)
peg-line-cut.rule: A Physical sword hit that gives you 4 Metal buff stacks (+1.2 % Physical damage dealt each) for 10 s.

phantom-sword.name: Phantom Sword (Huyễn Ảnh Kiếm)
phantom-sword.rule: Each of its hits and each crit of yours leaves an Afterimage; on a crit with 3 Afterimages, your last art fires again at 60 % and spends them. Fired with 4 Afterimages, Flurry Stance on, or 3 Bleed on the foe it hits 1.3 times as hard; the firing after that needs 7 Afterimages and either three canon arts in one pulse, you at 40 % health or less, or Flurry on; it spends 6 Afterimages and is three cuts of 2.8 times the force.

pinning-arrow.name: Pinning Arrow (Đinh Tiễn)
pinning-arrow.rule: Lays a Slowed Time stack, then delays the foe's longest timer by 0.35 s for every Slowed Time stack the foe bears. A critical hit lays 2 more stacks.

qi-shaking-palm.name: Qi-Shaking Palm (Chấn Khí Chưởng)
qi-shaking-palm.rule: A plain force palm: no element, cut only by Force resistance.

quarry-offering.name: Quarry Offering (Thạch Tế)
quarry-offering.rule: Costs 7 % of your health as well as linh lực, gives 8 Earth stacks for 15 s, and every 5 Earth stacks you hold make your Earth hits deal 3 % more (no cap). Fired again with 8 stacks it spends 8 for a 1.8 times hit and heals 5 %; then with 14 stacks and either 3 deep-vein arts in 8 s or under 40 % health it spends 14 for a 4.5 times Sundering hit and heals 10 %.

quench.name: Quench (Tôi Thiết)
quench.rule: No hit. Only while you bear Sealed Meridian: cleanses curses with the seal tag from you.

quick-draw-cut.name: Quick Draw Cut (Tật Xuất Kiếm Trảm)
quick-draw-cut.rule: A fast, cheap Physical sword hit: the main source of crit rolls.

re-temper.name: Re-Temper (Hồi Tôi)
re-temper.rule: At 70 % health or less: heals and gives back its cost; for 3 s after it, +10 on your L5.

reaping-saber.name: Reaping Saber (Cát Đao)
reaping-saber.rule: A heavy Physical saber hit; if it leaves the foe at 8 % health or less, the foe falls.

reckless-gale.name: Reckless Gale (Mệnh Phong Bộ)
reckless-gale.rule: Costs 6 % of your health on top of a small linh lực cost, then grants +10 % art speed for 8 s for every 10 % of health you are missing. Fired within 5 s of itself or at 60 % health it hits 2 times as hard; the firing after that, at 50 % health and also against a foe at 30 % or with 6 Wind stacks, burns 4 Wind stacks (a 0.3 hit for each one burned) to hit 3.5 times as hard for 12 % health.

red-lotus-ring.name: Red Lotus Ring (Xích Liên Ấn)
red-lotus-ring.rule: A Fire hit that lays 3 Burn stacks for 8 s on the foe and gives you 2 Fire buff stacks for 10 s: one cast feeds both sides of Fire.

red-sun-descends.name: Red Sun Descends (Hồng Nhật Giáng)
red-sun-descends.rule: Counts as a Red Sun Scripture art. A slow Fire seal that lays 4 Burn stacks for 6 s. In Brazier Form, or with 6 Heat, it falls twice as hard.

rekindle.name: Rekindle (Phục Hỏa)
rekindle.rule: A Fire hit; whenever it crits (at most 2 times a pulse) it lays 3 more Burn stacks for 4 s on the foe. Crit chance becomes Burn.

riding-the-gust.name: Riding the Gust (Thừa Phong)
riding-the-gust.rule: Each time you evade you gain 1 Wind buff stack for 4 s, up to 3 a pulse: dodging makes you faster.

rime-brand.name: Rime Brand (Băng Ấn)
rime-brand.rule: Hits and lays 4 Ice stacks for 10 s on the foe.

rime-lock-seal.name: Rime-Lock Seal (Sương Tỏa Ấn)
rime-lock-seal.rule: A seal strike that reads your Ice stacks on the foe: each full 10 adds a Heavy Breath curse (their art costs up 25 %, two at most). Fired again with 10 Ice stacks, a cursed foe or two arts of its canon this pulse it locks harder and delays their slowest art; a third firing with 15 Ice stacks on the foe and either two Heavy Breath or a Shatter Palm within 3 s eats 10 stacks and delays every art.

rime-mantle.name: Rime Mantle (Sương Giáp)
rime-mantle.rule: Raises a body shield of 12 % of your health; each hit you take lays 1 Ice stack for 8 s on the attacker.

rime-needle.name: Rime Needle (Sương Châm)
rime-needle.rule: A quick cold hit that lays 8 Ice stacks for 5 s on the foe, raising their art costs.

ripening-curse.name: Ripening Curse (Thục Chú)
ripening-curse.rule: A chaos hit that lays Stagnation and hits 3 % harder (damage more) for every different status already on the foe. Fired in a row, it ripens: a Budding Curse (1.4 times, 2 more Stagnation) when the foe has 2 Stagnation or you fired Fraying Thread within 4 s, then a Blooming Curse (3 times, 3 more Stagnation) at 5 Stagnation, 4 different statuses or 5 Fray.

rolling-barrage-fist.name: Rolling Barrage Fist (Cổn Liên Quyền)
rolling-barrage-fist.rule: Holds 4 charges of a quick fist hit; each firing adds 6 % crit for 4 s (stacking), crits shorten your other arts' timers, and every fist art you fire writes a Tempo (no cap). The fist falls plain, then as a Cascade at 4 times (4 Tempo), then as a Hundred-Fist Rain of four hits that each strike at 3 times (8 Tempo, three scripture arts within 2 s, or a foe Slowed 3 deep).

rolling-peal.name: Rolling Peal (Cổn Lôi)
rolling-peal.rule: A slow, heavy lightning hit: long cooldown, big coefficient.

rolling-thunder.name: Rolling Thunder (Hậu Lôi)
rolling-thunder.rule: Waits until the foe is at or below 50 % health, then fires: the follow-up to a volley.

rooted-form.name: Rooted Form (Cắm Rễ Thế)
rooted-form.rule: Toggles Rooted Form: health regeneration, healing and damage reduction up, arts 20 % slower, and Thorn Rain is suppressed. Each pulse in the form puts 2 Poison stacks on the foe and plants a Seed, plus 2 more Poison for every 10 Wood stacks you hold.

rot-seed.name: Rot Seed (Hủ Chủng)
rot-seed.rule: A quick hit that lays 4 Poison stacks for 10 s: thin, long batches.

scatter-gale.name: Scatter Gale (Tán Phong)
scatter-gale.rule: Blows 2 debuff stack batches off you, oldest first.

scorch-fist.name: Scorch Fist (Chước Hỏa Quyền)
scorch-fist.rule: A Physical fist hit of which half is converted to Fire (it meets Physical and Fire defence in halves) and lays 3 Burn stacks for 5 s. While the foe carries 12 Burn stacks or more, the whole hit is Fire.

seal-slam.name: Seal Slam (Ấn Áp)
seal-slam.rule: The seal grows and falls: a slow, heavy Physical hit.

second-spring.name: Second Spring (Tái Xuân)
second-spring.rule: Heals you when you are at 95 % health or less. Every heal from a healing art counts a Spring, and at 3 Springs your last art fires again at 40 % (once more per further 3), resetting the count. Fired with 6 Wood stacks, 2 Seeds or in Rooted Form it heals more and strikes; the firing after that, with 3 Springs or you at 40 % health or less, heals hugely, strikes for a great hit and fires your last art again in full.

second-wind.name: Second Wind (Hồi Khí)
second-wind.rule: Heals when your health is at or below 70 %.

seed-of-spring.name: Seed of Spring (Xuân Chủng)
seed-of-spring.rule: Hits and gives you 4 Wood stacks for 8 s; each landing banks a Seed (up to 3), and your next art fired, whatever it is, sprouts every banked Seed into 4 more Wood stacks on you, 3 Poison on the foe and a 1.5 % heal. Fired with 4 Seeds (spent; every Wood art you land plants one) and 8 Wood stacks on you, the hit lands 3.5 times as hard; or with 8 Poison stacks on the foe (eaten, every 4 also a Chaos hit) it lands 2.5 times as hard.

seep-through-palm.name: Seep-Through Palm (Thấm Cốt Chưởng)
seep-through-palm.rule: Half of this strike is Physical and half stays Water, so it meets both the foe's body and ward defences. Each hit speeds your other arts toward ready by 0.4 s (once a pulse).

shatter-edge-cleave.name: Shatter-Edge Cleave (Toái Nhận Trảm)
shatter-edge-cleave.rule: A heavy Physical cleave. If the foe carries 6 Metal debuff stacks it breaks up to 12 of them, each 2 broken striking again for 0.7 coefficient; or it spends 5 Temper while you hold 3 Metal buff stacks; or, with 2 Temper, it spends 8 of your own Metal buff stacks. Any of the three makes the cleave a Shattering Blow of 4 times the force.

shatter-palm.name: Shatter Palm (Toái Băng Chưởng)
shatter-palm.rule: A heavy cold palm that lays 3 Ice stacks for 6 s. With 10 Ice stacks on the foe and 2 Frost it shatters them all: a big hit and a cold free hit for every stack eaten; against Slowed Time, a foe at 30 % health or less, or from the Deep Winter form it shatters 5 stacks for a smaller hit.

shattering-fist.name: Shattering Fist (Toái Quyền)
shattering-fist.rule: A heavy Physical fist hit that strips up to 4 stacks from the foe's largest buff pile.

shattering-mantle.name: Shattering Mantle (Toái Băng Giáp)
shattering-mantle.rule: Raises a body shield of 20 % of your health; when it breaks it bursts for a cold hit and 12 Ice stacks, and again for more against a foe with 10 Ice stacks. Fired again with a shield standing, at half health or against 6 Ice stacks it slams down as a huge strike and thickens the shield; a third firing with 12 Ice stacks on the foe and either a shield standing or two arts of its sutra this pulse eats those stacks for a bigger slam and a new shield.

shearing-palm.name: Shearing Palm (Cắt Xé Chưởng)
shearing-palm.rule: A force palm of which half becomes Chaos: that half meets Chaos resistance and passes shields, the other half meets Force defence. When it crits, the palm tears again for a 1.8 chaos hit.

sheathe-and-breathe.name: Sheathe and Breathe (Thu Kiếm Điều Tức)
sheathe-and-breathe.rule: Restores 6 % of your maximum linh lực.

sheathed-edge.name: Sheathed Edge (Nhập Sao Nhận)
sheathed-edge.rule: Every crit you land banks a keen strike, up to 4; your next art fired releases them all as free Physical hits of 0.5 coefficient. Fired again with 4 Temper or 2 Sundered on the foe it draws twice as hard, and the firing after that, with 3 Temper and either three scripture arts fired in one pulse or you at 40 % health or less, draws three and a half times as hard.

shedding-bark.name: Shedding Bark (Thoát Bì)
shedding-bark.rule: While you carry Stagnation, cleanses 2 of your debuffs: the answer to the Salt-Sower.

sieve-palm.name: Sieve Palm (Sàng Chưởng)
sieve-palm.rule: A palm that lays 1 Wind debuff stack (−1.2 pp evade) for 4 s.

silencing-seal.name: Silencing Seal (Cấm Ngôn Ấn)
silencing-seal.rule: Applies Silence: arts with one named tag cannot fire for 3 pulses.

sinking-weight.name: Sinking Weight (Trầm Trọng Ấn)
sinking-weight.rule: An Earth seal that lays 3 Earth stacks on the foe. Fired again it spends 6 of them for a heavier hit and 2 Slowed Time (or opens on 4 Strata), then spends 9 for a 3.5 times hit, 3 more Slowed Time and a 2 s delay on every foe art (or opens in Mountain Stance, or on a foe already Slowed 4 deep).

sleet-volley.name: Sleet Volley (Tuyết Vũ Tiễn)
sleet-volley.rule: Holds 3 charges; each firing throws 5 icicles, and every icicle that lands lays 1 Ice stack for 8 s, 2 more if it crits. A spent charge returns after the minimum cooldown, all of them after the full cooldown.

slow-rot.name: Slow Rot (Hủ Hoa)
slow-rot.rule: Hits and lays 2 Poison stacks for 20 s.

soul-song-seal-ledger-stamp.name: Ledger Stamp (Lục Ấn Áp)
soul-song-seal-ledger-stamp.rule: Counts as a Nine Seal Ledger art. A slow, heavy seal stamp that adds a Seal. With 2 Seals and either an Exposed foe, a Slackened Soul foe, or another ledger seal fired the same pulse, the stamp is entered in the ledger: 2.8 times as hard, it spends 2 Seals and exposes the foe.

soul-song-seal-raindrop-pluck.name: Raindrop Pluck (Vũ Lạc Huyền)
soul-song-seal-raindrop-pluck.rule: One light note that strikes the foe's soul. Each soul hit you land adds a Toll (once a pulse), so it feeds the Tolling Bell Requiem from any hand.

soul-song-seal-thousand-string-dirge.name: Thousand-String Dirge (Thiên Huyền Điếu)
soul-song-seal-thousand-string-dirge.rule: Counts as a Hollow Bell Canon art. A soul strike on the foe. Every song art you fire adds a Chord. With 3 Chords and either a Slackened Soul foe or another canon art fired the same pulse, the strings answer in chorus: a heavy extra soul strike that spends 3 Chords and adds 2 Tolls to the Bell. The next, with 6 Chords and either 2 Slackened Soul on the foe or you at 40 % health or less, spends 6 Chords for another and slackens the foe's soul.

soul-song-seal-tolled-prick.name: Tolled Prick (Chung Điểm Thích)
soul-song-seal-tolled-prick.rule: A thin soul prick that adds a Toll on each soul hit (once a pulse). At 3 Tolls the needle rings the bell itself: a heavier extra soul strike that spends the 3 Tolls. It needs no Chord, only the Toll rhythm you already keep.

spring-sap.name: Spring Sap (Xuân Dịch)
spring-sap.rule: Hits and gives you 6 Wood stacks for 10 s (health regeneration).

stagnant-qi-seal.name: Stagnant Qi Seal (Trệ Khí Ấn)
stagnant-qi-seal.rule: Lays 3 Stagnation: the foe's linh lực and health regeneration are cut 1 % per stack.

static-charge.name: Static Charge (Tĩnh Điện)
static-charge.rule: A small lightning hit that grants you 3 Thunder buff stacks (accuracy and crit chance) for 12 s.

static-veil.name: Static Veil (Điện Mạc)
static-veil.rule: Raises a body shield of 10 % of your health; each hit you take lays 1 Thunder stack for 8 s on the attacker.

still-pool-mending.name: Still Pool Mending (Tĩnh Trì Hồi Khí)
still-pool-mending.rule: Heals you when you are at 90 % health or less, and gives 3 Water stacks for 14 s.

stilled-instant.name: Stilled Instant (Đình Thời Ấn)
stilled-instant.rule: Hits and lays Slowed Time; every full 10 Ice stacks on the foe also freeze 0.5 s onto every art timer they have. Fired again against 2 Slowed Time, 10 Ice stacks or two arts of its sutra this pulse, time stops harder (bigger hit, slowest art delayed); a third firing against 15 Ice stacks and either 3 Slowed Time or two sutra arts this pulse eats 10 stacks and delays every art by 2 s.

stone-rebuke.name: Stone Rebuke (Thạch Báo)
stone-rebuke.rule: Gives you 3 Earth buff stacks for 10 s. While equipped, a hit you take is answered by a free Physical hit of 0.5 (once every 3 s).

stone-skin-seal.name: Stone-Skin Seal (Thạch Bì Ấn)
stone-skin-seal.rule: Raises a body shield of 15 % of your health and gives you 3 Earth stacks for 12 s.

stone-warden-call.name: Stone Warden Call (Thạch Vệ Triệu)
stone-warden-call.rule: Raises a stone warden for 14 s that strikes for 0.7 Physical every 3 s, 8 % faster per 3 Earth stacks you hold. Fired again with 6 Earth stacks it spends 6 for a second warden; then with 12 stacks and either 3 deep-vein arts in 10 s, under half health or a Slowed foe it spends 12 for two fast wardens and a 4 times slam.

storm-bank.name: Storm Bank (Tích Lôi Ngân)
storm-bank.rule: Holds 3 bolts that can be fired back to back, each costing linh lực and 3 % of your health; all return after the cooldown. Each bolt raises all your damage by 2 % for 3 s, stacking, and below half health each also lays 2 Thunder debuff stacks on the foe.

stormcloud-familiar.name: Stormcloud Familiar (Lôi Vân Linh)
stormcloud-familiar.rule: Calls a small storm cloud that strikes for 0.08 every 2 s for 9 s. Each crit the cloud lands lays 1 Thunder debuff stack on the foe, up to 2 a pulse.

strata-hammer.name: Strata Hammer (Tầng Nham Chùy)
strata-hammer.rule: Every Earth art you fire, this one included, lays a Stratum on you (no cap). The hammer falls plain, then as a Fault Line at 2.5 times (spending 4 Strata and up to 6 of the foe's Earth stacks), then as a Collapse at 5 times that Sunders the foe (needs 8 Strata, spends them, and also needs the foe Slowed 3 deep, three canon arts within 2 s, or Mountain Stance); a failed step starts the chain over.

string-cut.name: String Cut (Cầm Huyền Trảm)
string-cut.rule: One plucked string sends a blade of sound: a plain Force hit.

sundering-cut.name: Sundering Cut (Phá Giáp Trảm)
sundering-cut.rule: A Physical sword hit that lays 1 Sundered stack (-150 points of resistance to the hit's type, up to 3 stacks).

sundering-wedge.name: Sundering Wedge (Liệt Thạch Tiết)
sundering-wedge.rule: A Physical hit that lays 2 Sundered (-150 resistance points a stack, up to 3) for 6 s. Fired into a foe already at 2 Sundered, or with another art of this canon fired that pulse, it cracks them open: 2.5 times the force and Exposed for 3 pulses. The firing after that, with the foe at 2 Sundered and either 6 Metal stacks on it or another canon art fired that pulse, breaks up to 12 stacks (each 3 broken a free 0.6 hit) for 4 times the force and Exposed again.

swallow-stance.name: Swallow Stance (Yến Hành Thế)
swallow-stance.rule: A stance you toggle: basic attacks are 10 % faster and you gain 12 evade, but your arts are 25 % slower. In it each evade gives 1 Wind buff stack for 5 s, up to 3 a pulse.

sweeping-the-floor.name: Sweeping the Floor (Tảo Trường)
sweeping-the-floor.rule: When you are Silenced, cleanses 1 debuff batch from you; it carries no wind tag, so a Silence naming wind cannot stop it.

swelling-tide-palm.name: Swelling Tide Palm (Doanh Triều Chưởng)
swelling-tide-palm.rule: Every Water art you fire, and every time you are healed (once a pulse), adds a Tide; Tide has no cap. With 5 Tide and 3 Water stacks the palm breaks them as five waves, eats the Water stacks for a free hit each and returns 3 % linh lực; with 3 Tide at 60 % health or less it breaks three waves.

thorn-chorus.name: Thorn Chorus (Kinh Hợp Xướng)
thorn-chorus.rule: A Physical hit that deals more for every hit you have taken this fight: +5 % damage a hit, up to 10 hits.

thorn-lullaby.name: Thorn Lullaby (Cức Mộng Ru)
thorn-lullaby.rule: Heals you and raises a body shield of 8 % of your health. Every time you are healed, from any source, thorns of the song strike the foe's soul (up to 3 times a pulse).

thorn-rain.name: Thorn Rain (Thích Vũ)
thorn-rain.rule: Splits into 6 thorns; each thorn that lands lays 1 Poison stack for 6 s and each crit thorn lays 1 more. Every thorn rolls to crit and to be evaded on its own.

thornling-grove.name: Thornling Grove (Thích Linh Lâm)
thornling-grove.rule: Hits, lays 2 Poison stacks for 10 s and raises a Thornling that strikes with Chaos every 2 s for 12 s; each Thornling strike seeds 1 Poison stack. Fired again with 10 Poison on the foe, 2 canopy arts in a pulse, or 14 s since the last grove, a second Thornling rises and the hit triples; the firing after that, with 25 Poison, 3 Stagnation or 3 canopy arts in a pulse, raises two more, eats up to 15 Poison to raise one more per 5, and hits six times as hard.

thread-lightning-brand.name: Thread-Lightning Brand (Lôi Ấn)
thread-lightning-brand.rule: A small lightning hit that lays 3 Thunder debuff stacks (more crit chance and crit damage taken) for 10 s.

three-step-chase.name: Three-Step Chase (Tam Bộ Truy Phong)
three-step-chase.rule: Holds 3 charges: fire all three in quick succession, each giving +20 evade for 2 s. Each Stride in the last 6 s makes your dash arts hit 4 % more.

threshing-rain.name: Threshing Rain (Đả Cốc Vũ)
threshing-rain.rule: Grants you 1 Wind buff stack and lays 1 Wind debuff stack on the foe, each for 4 s.

through-the-mountain.name: Through the Mountain (Xuyên Sơn)
through-the-mountain.rule: A heavy Physical hit that passes 10 % of the foe's ward (bypass). The heavy blow of a piercing build; Notch the Foe's stacks set it up.

thunder-forked-slash.name: Forked Slash (Phân Lôi Trảm)
thunder-forked-slash.rule: Counts as a Thousand-Bolt Scripture art. A quick Lightning slash; each crit it lands raises your crit chance by 5 for 3 s, stacking. In Overload Form, or with 3 Charges or 3 Peals, or three scripture arts fired in one pulse, it hits 2.2 times as hard.

thunder-needle.name: Thunder Needle (Lôi Châm)
thunder-needle.rule: A cheap lightning hit that applies Leaking Ward: the foe's drain wards bill 50 % more for 3 pulses.

thunder-ninth-verdict.name: Ninth Verdict (Cửu Kiếp Phán)
thunder-ninth-verdict.rule: Counts as a Heavenly Tribulation Scripture art. A slow Lightning seal that lays 4 Thunder stacks for 8 s; each crit it lands lays 1 more (twice a pulse at most). With 6 Thunder stacks on the foe and also a foe Slowed twice, a foe at 50 % health or three scripture arts in one pulse, it consumes 6 of them to hit 6 times as hard.

thunder-spark-prick.name: Spark Prick (Lôi Tinh Thích)
thunder-spark-prick.rule: A needle of static: a quick Lightning hit that lays 2 Thunder stacks on the foe for 6 s.

thunderclap-bind.name: Thunderclap Bind (Lôi Phược)
thunderclap-bind.rule: A hit that lays Slowed Time x2; while the foe is slowed, each crit pushes its longest art cooldown back 0.6 s, twice a pulse at most. Into a Slowed foe, a foe with 4 Thunder stacks or a foe at 60 % linh lực or less it hits twice as hard and delays their longest timer 1 s; the firing after that, with 4 Thunder stacks on the foe and also 2 Slowed Time, 3 Peals or three arts of its scripture in one pulse, hits 4 times as hard and delays every timer 1 s.

tide-pulse.name: Tide Pulse (Triều Xung)
tide-pulse.rule: Hits and gives you 3 Water stacks for 12 s.

tolling-bell-requiem.name: Tolling Bell Requiem (Điếu Chung Khúc)
tolling-bell-requiem.rule: Every soul hit you land adds a Toll, and Tolls fade slowly (1 every 4 pulses). Each time you ring the bell it strikes the foe's soul once more for every Toll you hold, with no limit. With 3 Tolls, 1 Slackened Soul on the foe, or another art of the canon fired the same pulse, the next ring is a Great Peal that spends 3 Tolls for a heavy extra soul strike; the ring after that, with 5 Tolls and either 2 Slackened Soul on the foe or you at 40 % health or less, is a Death Knell that spends 6 Tolls for a far heavier one and slackens the foe's soul.

trailing-gale.name: Trailing Gale (Lưu Phong Chướng)
trailing-gale.rule: Hits and lays 2 Slowed Time on the foe. While the foe is Slowed, each time you evade pushes their longest timer back 0.5 s, up to twice a pulse. Fired into a Slowed or dry foe it hits 2 times as hard and delays their longest timer 1 s; the firing after that, at 3 Slowed Time and also 5 Slowed Time, three slow-hour arts in one pulse or 3 Echoes, hits 3.5 times as hard and delays every timer 1 s.

tremor-palm.name: Tremor Palm (Chấn Thổ Chưởng)
tremor-palm.rule: An Earth hit that lays 2 Earth debuff stacks (-1.2 pp accuracy each) for 8 s.

tribulation-seal.name: Tribulation Seal (Kiếp Lôi Ấn)
tribulation-seal.rule: Lays 4 Thunder debuff stacks for 8 s; every pulse the foe carries 8 or more, heaven strikes it for 0.02 per 4 stacks with no limit. With 4 stacks on the foe, 4 Charges or a Slowed foe the Seal hits twice as hard, and the firing after that, at 6 stacks and also a Slowed foe (2), a foe at 50 % health or three arts of its scripture in one pulse, calls down the verdict: it consumes 6 of the foe's stacks to hit 5 times as hard.

triple-draw.name: Triple Draw (Tam Bạt Đao)
triple-draw.rule: Holds 3 charges; a spent charge returns after the minimum cooldown and all return after 6 s. Each draw in the last 4 s adds a 0.15-coefficient cut to the hit, and a draw with 2 draws in 4 s and either 2 Bleed on the foe, three canon arts in one pulse, or you at 40 % health or less hits 1.9 times as hard.

twin-flame-echo.name: Twin Flame Echo (Song Diễm Hưởng)
twin-flame-echo.rule: Every Fire art you fire counts a Twin flame (up to 3). At 3 flames and in Brazier Form, or with 30 Burn on the foe, or after three Red Sun arts in 3 s, this art blooms: it hits two and a fifth times as hard and your last art fires again at three quarters strength, spending the flames.

twin-shadow-fist.name: Twin Shadow Fist (Song Ảnh Quyền)
twin-shadow-fist.rule: A fist hit that calls a shadow double for 12 s, which strikes every 2.5 s. Each crit of your arts quickens the double by 12 % for 4 s (stacking), and each pulse the double lands a hit writes a Tempo for the Barrage Fist.

underground-spring.name: Underground Spring (Ám Tuyền)
underground-spring.rule: Hits and gives you 6 Water stacks for 10 s: the Water twin of Spring Sap.

undertow.name: Undertow (Ám Lưu)
undertow.rule: A cold blade that waits ready until the foe's linh lực is dry (5 % or less), then strikes.

unravelling-seal.name: Unravelling Seal (Hỗn Giải Ấn)
unravelling-seal.rule: A hit that applies Sundered: the foe's resistance to the hit's largest type falls 150 points per stack.

venom-drinking-root.name: Venom-Drinking Root (Hấp Độc Căn)
venom-drinking-root.rule: Hits and lays 2 Poison stacks for 15 s; every chaos tick you deal then heals you for 0.4 % of your health (once a pulse).

venom-tithe.name: Venom Tithe (Độc Thuế)
venom-tithe.rule: Hits, lays 3 Poison stacks for 13 s and restores 2 % of your linh lực.

warm-the-hearth.name: Warm the Hearth (Noãn Lô Quyết)
warm-the-hearth.rule: A small Fire hit that gives you 3 Fire buff stacks for 15 s (each +1.2 % damage dealt).

water-abyss-seal-descends.name: Abyss Seal Descends (Uyên Ấn Trụy)
water-abyss-seal-descends.rule: Counts as an Undertow Litany art. A slow Water seal that adds a Slowed Time stack and delays the foe's slowest-ready art by 1 s. With 4 Slowed Time on the foe and two Undertow Litany arts fired in the last second, it drops four and a half times as hard and delays every art of the foe by 1.5 s.

water-anchor-falls-on-the-tide.name: Anchor Falls on the Tide (Mao Trầm Triều)
water-anchor-falls-on-the-tide.rule: Counts as a Still Moon Tide Scripture art. A slow, heavy Water drop; every Water art you fire adds a Tide (twice a pulse at most). With 3 Tide, and either the Deep Lake or 4 Water stacks, the anchor falls 2.5 times as hard and spends the 3 Tide.

water-curtain.name: Water Curtain (Thủy Liêm Chướng)
water-curtain.rule: Raises a body shield of 12 % of your health and gives you 3 Water stacks for 12 s.

water-dew-prick.name: Dew Prick (Lộ Châm Thích)
water-dew-prick.rule: A fine needle of water: a quick Water hit that gives you 1 Water stack for 8 s.

water-gourd-pours-the-pool.name: Gourd Pours the Pool (Hồ Lô Khuynh Trì)
water-gourd-pours-the-pool.rule: The gourd tips out a pool: a Water hit that gives you 2 Water stacks for 10 s. With 6 Water stacks it pours three of them out as a hit 2.2 times as hard.

weeping-sap.name: Weeping Sap (Khấp Dịch)
weeping-sap.rule: Heals you when you are at 90 % health or less, and gives 3 Wood stacks for 14 s.

well-mouth-spring.name: Spring at the Well's Mouth (Tỉnh Khẩu Tuyền)
well-mouth-spring.rule: Heals when you are at 70 % health or less and gives back the linh lực it cost.

whetstone-pass.name: Whetstone Pass (Mài Phong Chưởng)
whetstone-pass.rule: Every Metal art you fire adds a Temper that lasts 10 s, and each Temper gives your Metal arts +1 crit chance, with no cap. With 6 Temper and either 4 Metal stacks on the foe or another art of this scripture fired the same pulse, the pass becomes a Honed Pass: it spends 3 Temper, hits 2.5 times as hard and gives you 4 Metal buff stacks for 8 s.

whistle-in.name: Whistle In (Hô Hổ)
whistle-in.rule: Your companion acts 20 % faster for 3 s.

wind-fanning-gust.name: Fanning Gust (Quạt Phong Trận)
wind-fanning-gust.rule: One sweep of the fan: a quick Wind hit that gives you 2 Wind buff stacks for 6 s.

wind-heron-takes-wing.name: Heron Takes Wing (Lộ Khởi Phong)
wind-heron-takes-wing.rule: Counts as a Gale Courier Scripture art. A quick Wind sweep that gives you 2 Wind buff stacks for 6 s. With 5 Feathers, and either Swallow Stance up or three courier arts fired in one pulse, the heron takes wing: 3.5 times as hard, burning 3 of your Wind stacks.

wind-stitch-the-hour.name: Stitch the Hour (Phùng Thời)
wind-stitch-the-hour.rule: Counts as a Slow-Hour Scripture art. A quick Wind needle that lays 1 Slowed Time for 3 s. With the foe at 3 Slowed Time, or with 3 Echoes, the needle hits 2.5 times as hard.

winnings.name: Winnings (Thắng Lợi)
winnings.rule: A lightning hit that also returns 3 % of your maximum linh lực.

withering-touch.name: Withering Touch (Khô Thủ)
withering-touch.rule: Hits, curses the foe with Withering (healing taken down 50 %) and lays 1 Poison stack for 12 s.

wood-bramble-flick.name: Bramble Flick (Kinh Cức Đạn)
wood-bramble-flick.rule: A thorn flicked from a needle: a quick Wood hit that lays 2 Poison stacks for 8 s.

wood-fell-the-rotting.name: Fell the Rotting Tree (Phạt Hủ Mộc)
wood-fell-the-rotting.rule: Counts as a Rotting Canopy Canon art. A heavy Wood chop that lays 2 Poison stacks for 8 s. With 10 Poison on the foe, or 2 canopy arts fired in the last second, it eats 8 Poison stacks (every 4 a Chaos hit) and falls 2.4 times as hard.

wood-seal-of-turning-seasons.name: Seal of the Turning Season (Chuyển Quý Ấn)
wood-seal-of-turning-seasons.rule: Counts as a Verdant Cycle Scripture art. A slow Wood seal that gives you 3 Wood stacks for 8 s. With 3 Seeds (spent) and either Rooted Form or 8 Wood stacks, it falls 2.8 times as hard and heals 2 %.

writ-of-reckoning.name: Writ of Reckoning (Thúc Nợ Trạng)
writ-of-reckoning.rule: A Physical hit that lays 3 Metal debuff stacks for 6 s and Withering (healing taken -50 %) for 2 pulses. The answer to a healer.

blade-mirror-trace-sword.name: Mirror-Trace Flying Sword (Kính Ngấn Phi Kiếm)

blade-rain-calling-sword.name: Rain-Calling Flying Sword (Hoán Vũ Phi Kiếm)

reserve_arts.name: Sword Intent Aura (Kiếm Ý Quang)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, your sword arts are 8 % faster and deal 6 % more.

blade-thousand-cut-sword.name: Thousand-Cut Returning Sword (Thiên Trảm Hồi Kiếm)

blade-thread-edge-sword.name: Thread-Edge Flying Sword (Ti Nhận Phi Kiếm)

blade-twin-edge-sword.name: Twin-Edge Flying Sword (Song Nhận Phi Kiếm)

blade-unbroken-edge-ring.name: Ring of Unbroken Edges (Bất Đoạn Nhận Giới)

reserve_arts.name: Unbroken Edge Aura (Bất Đoạn Nhận Quang)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, your sword arts crit 8 % more often and are 12 % faster.

body-first-stand-pendant.name: Pendant of the First Stand (Tiên Lập Bội)

body-flesh-seal.name: Seal of Unbroken Flesh (Bất Hoại Nhục Ấn)

body-iron-skin-ring.name: Ring of Renewed Iron Skin (Thiết Bì Phục Giới)

body-stone-answer-ring.name: Ring of the Answering Stone (Ứng Thạch Giới)

reserve_arts.name: Stone-Marrow Aura (Thạch Tủy Quang)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, your body shields are 10 % stronger and you gain 10 block.

body-tempered-marrow-ring.name: Ring of Tempered Marrow (Luyện Tủy Giới)

body-vajra-hide-armour.name: Vajra-Hide Armour (Kim Cương Bì Giáp)
effects: Shield Pays the Blood (Thuẫn Thế Huyết)

earth-boundary-flag.name: Boundary Flag of the Field Lord (Điền Chủ Giới Kỳ)

earth-dust-veil-robe.name: Robe of Settling Dust (Trần Lạc Đạo Bào)

earth-remembering-stone-pendant.name: Pendant of the Remembering Stone (Thạch Ký Bội)

reserve_arts.name: Still Stone Aura (Tĩnh Thạch Quang)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, your Earth buff stacks are 15 % stronger and you resist 100 points more Physical damage.

earth-stone-debt-necklace.name: Necklace of Stone Debt (Thạch Trái Liên)

earth-unmoving-gate-shield.name: Unmoving Gate Shield (Bất Động Môn Thuẫn)

fire-ashen-phoenix-fan.name: Ashen Phoenix Fan (Tro Phượng Phiến)
effects: Fan the Pyre (Phiến Hỏa Liệu Nguyên)

fire-blood-kindling-ring.name: Ring of Blood Kindling (Huyết Dẫn Giới)

fire-hearth-ember-ring.name: Ring of the Fed Hearth (Dưỡng Lô Giới)
effects: Embers Feed the Hearth (Tàn Hỏa Dưỡng Lô)

reserve_arts.name: Hearth Aura (Lô Hỏa Quang)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, your Burn batches last 25 % longer and your Fire debuff stacks are 10 % stronger.

fire-undying-ember-lantern.name: Undying Ember Lantern (Bất Diệt Tàn Đăng)
effects: Embers Never Die (Tàn Hỏa Bất Diệt)
